description: The Cooks Standard 12-Inch/30cm nonstick hard anodized fry saute omelet pan, Black has a hard anodized surface that is durable, thick, and harder than stainless steel. The heavy gauge aluminum core distributes heat quickly/evenly and prevents hot spots. Nonstick coating delivers exceptional performance, makes cleaning easy, and allows for healthier cooking. Long stainless steel handle stays cool/comfortable and is riveted for strength. Flat and wide bottom for a large cooking surface. Sloped sides for tossing and holding more food. Tapered lip for drip-free pouring. Works on gas, electric, glass, ceramic, halogen etc. Oven safe to 450F. Not induction compatible. Dishwasher safe, hand wash recommended.
